rules.sentence: In other systemic diseases or in ITP, spontaneous or even severe bleeding is usually not observed if the platelet count exceeds 10 × 109/L.
In cases of patients with thrombocytopenia, concomitant platelet dysfunction is suspected if bleeding is disproportionate to the patient’s platelet count.
In some IPDs with mild impairment of platelet function, bleeding is not an essential feature, and a lack of bleeding manifestations does not rule out the diagnosis.
